The Eileen Graham Collection (Discovery Bay, Jamaica, 1966 to 1968)

Download:

Jamaica
Discovery Bay
1960s
A set of underwater photographs from Discovery Bay, Jamaica (1966 to 1968), taken by Eileen Graham. The photographs capture the north coast reefs in a state of vibrancy now largely lost. Trustees of the Natural History Museum, CC BY 4.0.
